text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival. An event 
held by inviting fans inside the Tracen 
Academy grounds.

Events like ball games featuring the 
Umamusume, which one rarely sees on 
ordinary days, are also held.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ball sports, huh? Sounds good! Hey, 
Trainer. When you think of major ball 
sports, it's gotta be *that* one, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, golf! Soccer's cool and all, but 
golf's where it's at! So that's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Today I'm the star of the show! Time to 
Palmer-charge right through with 
everything I've got!

And so, a golf tournament held on the 
renovated turf course began.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ I've never played before, but I 
definitely look the part more than any 
golfer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next is the 2nd shot... A 6-iron? 
No, I should definitely go with the 1-wood 
here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, number 1? It's not even a tee shot, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because if it's not first place, I feel 
like I've somehow lost to myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, here we go~. Right up close to 
the pin~. Ready, and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're hard at work! All right, me 
too!

And so, the competition progressed—and 
Mejiro Palmer brilliantly advanced all the 
way to the match play finals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, who's my opponent in the 
finals...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Palmer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon, huh. A Front Runner 
Umamusume just like me. We share the same 
running style, but...

Mejiro Palmer is the type to front-run by 
feeling, whereas Mihono Bourbon front-runs 
through precise calculation.

In a sense, a golf match of Heart vs. 
Brains. Just what will the outcome be?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Measuring. Wind speed: 3.8 m/s, 
north-northwest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If launched on a slicing trajectory, I 
predict it will land 0.52m beside the 
bunker.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Phase—initiating launch. 2, 1, huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there was an Umamusume who could hit 
a shot like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this one might be a formidable 
opponent!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Now it's my turn... Course is good, focus 
is good, all that's left—is the vibe to 
secure victory!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (If everyone is praying for my victory――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(......H-Huh? I don't really feel people 
watching. Could it be that my crowd is on 
the smaller side?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I guess Umamusume golf isn't very 
popular. Ah, whatever, here goes nothing!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yari, ra, fee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I duffed it! I totally messed up~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah...

Mejiro Palmer couldn't quite catch the 
wind, and then—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: The winner is—Mihono Bourbon!
(Clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew, you got me~. Congratulations, 
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing. She runs with that exact 
same precision in actual races, too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To tell the truth, my golf form today 
was—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Palmer-san, I have traced your movements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, mine...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because it was very logical. 
Actually—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've taken a few cues from her races, too. 
Her grit in the final stretch, especially, 
is marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
âRequest: Please continue to demonstrate 
examples of the ideal running form.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see~. You've even studied the other 
Umamusume's running styles that closely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess it was only natural I lost today. 
Still, I'd say I learned a valuable 
lesson!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon! Let's compete again, whether in a 
race or golf.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. I look forward to working 
with you.

Despite the loss, competing against a 
Front Runner with a different style seemed 
to have been an invaluable experience.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Palmer...! Do your best, Palmer...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
We're right here with you. Stay focused 
until the very end...

Glancing around, I saw many fans praying 
for Mejiro Palmer's success.

Surrounded by a massive army praying with 
hands clasped, Mejiro Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Here goes. Yari, ra, fee--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooohh!

"The greatest shot soared high, as if 
drawn into the blue sky, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: The winner is—Mejiro Palmer!
(Clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer! I felt so reassured 
with you by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Btw, wasn't my crowd of spectators weirdly 
huge?

Fans wearing the same pin badge gathered 
around the victorious Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Mejiro Palmer! We're your 
unofficial fan club!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, they're called 'Palmer's Army.' 
Every single one of them loves the way 
Mejiro Palmer runs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Palmer's Army...! I see, you've even got a 
group like that formed for you now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I'm so grateful for fans! And 
what's more......"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So it's not the Mejiro Army, it's Palmer's 
Army!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'm your own personal cheering 
squad!

Yeah, I'm your own personal cheering 
squad!

text_block_list.text:
As a result of running in pursuit of 
freedom, before I knew it, my grassroots 
fanbase had grown this much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone! Not just in golf, but in 
races too, I want to keep entertaining you 
more and more—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm going for a hole-in-one at the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)! Cheer me on, yaaay☆
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

Mejiro Palmer, enveloped in cheers. It was 
an event where we could feel a definite 
bond with the fans.
